claim: A practice run ends after three rounds.
sandbox: start a fresh deterministic practice run and submit the successful route three times

claim: Restart clears the prior practice run.
sandbox: complete one round, restart, then inspect the active round and delivered count

claim: The Scenario Set contains twelve more topology cards with rotating role views.
sandbox: open the landing page, count the visible Scenario Set topology cards, and inspect the four displayed role views

claim: Sample progress stays separate from a saved practice run.
sandbox: save a real West-route outcome, play and reset a demo Split-route outcome, then return to the unchanged real run

claim: On-screen route buttons and keys 1, 2, and 3 choose routes during a practice run.
sandbox: open the demo, choose one route with its on-screen button, then use key 1 for the next round

claim: The motion setting remains after reload.
sandbox: turn on reduced motion, reload the demo, and check the pressed state

claim: The sample run makes no cross-origin request.
sandbox: record all requests during a complete demo run and allow only the local product origin

claim: A sample run starts without a profile and makes no cross-origin analytics, tracker, font, or script request.
sandbox: open a fresh sample, finish the run, verify no profile form appears, and record every browser request origin

claim: Practice progress stays in this browser across reload.
sandbox: play one local round, reload the same browser, and confirm the saved round remains

claim: The sample opens a populated three-round board with labelled practice teammates.
sandbox: open the shipped demo URL and inspect its banner, relay board, first round, teammates, and route controls

claim: A complete practice run shows a result and can restart.
sandbox: play the successful demo path through its debrief and restart it

claim: A completed practice run ends with a game result and debrief, not a grading or credential step.
where: What Signal School does not do, terms page, README
sandbox: finish the sample run and inspect the available end-screen actions and fields

claim: The demo has no serious or critical automated accessibility finding.
sandbox: run axe against the fresh demo screen

claim: Demo, Privacy, Terms, and the fallback page have route-specific titles.
sandbox: open each route and read the browser title and fallback heading

claim: Signal School includes eight free and twelve Scenario Set distinct playable three-round topology cards, for twenty total.
sandbox: load every shipped card, compare its full playable round content, then play each card's correct three-route path to an ending

claim: Pause stops the storm clock until the run resumes.
sandbox: advance an active deterministic run, pause it, advance simulated time, then resume it

claim: The 390px phone check maintains 60 fps within a five-fps measurement margin under four-times CPU throttling.
sandbox: run the active demo in Chromium at 390px with four-times CPU throttling and measure requestAnimationFrame intervals

claim: Online rooms give real clients partial role views, vary topology and roles after restart, recover a reconnect, and reach shared win and loss results.
sandbox: start the product-owned local WebSocket service, use two independent browser clients, reload one client, play changing shared route plans across three topologies, and inspect the changed role views

claim: Online rooms support two to four players and reject a fifth player.
sandbox: use independent WebSocket clients to create a room, join through player four, then attempt a fifth join

claim: A room stored on durable SQLite remains available after the room service restarts.
sandbox: create a room against a temporary SQLite database, restart the service, and query the same room code

claim: The twelve built-in Scenario Set cards stay visible, with no checkout path, until the one-time offer is registered.
where: Scenario Set section, terms page, README
sandbox: open the Scenario Set and its terms from a fresh landing page, then inspect the available purchase actions

claim: Leaving an online room stops automatic reconnection after reload.
sandbox: create a local room, leave it, reload the same browser, and confirm the create-or-join room view remains

claim: Room lookups and new room connections return 429 with Retry-After after their request allowance; an open room receives a wait message.
sandbox: exceed room lookup and WebSocket-connection allowances, then exceed open-room messages and inspect their distinct observable responses

claim: A room host can delete the room and its server data for every player.
where: Privacy page, online room panel, README
sandbox: create a local room, confirm Delete room data, observe every browser return to the room form, and confirm the product service no longer finds the code

claim: Rooms with no update for 24 hours are deleted automatically.
sandbox: create a room against a temporary SQLite database, advance the service clock past 24 hours, restart the service, and confirm the room is absent
